meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会先派子代理去读文档和示例，确认真实存在的 API，再产出分阶段的实施计划。每个阶段都标明要照抄的文档位置、验证清单，以及不该做的事。
howto.when: 当你要规划一个功能、一个任务或多步实现时触发，尤其在你准备用 do 执行之前。正文把「文档发现」定为永远的第一步。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一份分阶段的实施计划
say.note: 会先查文档再划分阶段

say.text: 规划之前，先把相关文档和可用 API 查清楚
say.note: 对应 Phase 0 文档发现

say.text: 计划的每个阶段都写上验证清单和禁止事项
say.note: 阶段需含验证与反模式守卫

howto.what_en: Claude first deploys subagents to read docs and examples and confirm which APIs actually exist, then writes a phased implementation plan. Each phase cites the docs to copy, a verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing it with do. Documentation discovery is always the first phase.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this new feature
say_en.note: Runs doc discovery before writing phases

say_en.text: Before planning, look up the docs and the APIs that really exist
Give every phase a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards
